bathAction.title: Get in
bathAction.tooltip: Sink into the bath. The water reaches what the hands cannot. Half a minute.

description.text: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(step)] into the bath and [npc.verb(sink)] until the water takes the parts [npc.her] hands cannot. Heat closes over [npc.her] stomach and [npc.her] hips. [npc.speech(In. Let the water do the reaching.)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(climb)] into the bath and [npc.verb(sink)] with a long, pleased [npc.moan], letting the hot water cover [npc.herHim] as far as it will go. [npc.speech(All the way in. I want to be covered.)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(get)] into the bath and [npc.verb(drop)] down into it, letting the water hit the parts [npc.she] cannot be bothered to twist toward. [npc.speech(Soak. I am not climbing over myself to wash.)]
